verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents Markdown/MDX authoring with JSX syntax support (readme-docs-42, 81) and slash-command Mermaid diagrams (readme-docs-60), plus reusable Markdown blocks (readme-docs-24, 43), which supports building rich pages without raw HTML. However, the evidence never explicitly names built-in components like tabs, callouts, code groups, or step lists — only MDX/JSX generically and diagrams. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tabs/callout/code-group/step components, and independent/hands-on confirmation of their availability.
